verification_method: Live HTTP requests to the Hugging Face Hub API and raw repository file endpoints, metadata-only -- no weight shards downloaded during this verification step
architecture_notes: MoE (moe_intermediate_size, first_k_dense_replace present) with MLA-style attention (kv_lora_rank present) and a vision tower (vision_config present) -- multimodal, hybrid dense/MoE.
published_precision: FP8 (E4M3, static activation scaling) for the main MoE weights; BF16 retained for model.vision_tower, model.multi_modal_projector, and lm_head (quantization_config.modules_to_not_convert)
license_source: Hugging Face repository cardData.license (metadata tag) ONLY
license_repository_source_verified: NO -- no LICENSE/LICENSE.md/LICENCE/LICENSE.txt file was found in the repository at this revision (all returned 404). This is weaker evidence than the Qwen3.8-27B candidate's verified LICENSE file; the apache-2.0 claim rests on the metadata tag alone.

runtime_support_evidence.vllm: Explicitly recommended in the model's own README ('vLLM (Recommended)' section) with an official launch command: vllm serve mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603 --max-model-len 262144 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --attention-backend FLASH_ATTN_MLA --tool-call-parser mistral --enable-auto-tool-choice --reasoning-parser mistral --max_num_batched_tokens 16384 --max_num_seqs 128 --gpu_memory_utilization 0.8
runtime_support_evidence.native_transformers: README explicitly states: 'you need to install the main branch of Transformers to use Mistral Small 4' (git+https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git) -- the current stable PyPI release (5.17.0) is NOT confirmed sufficient for native load. This is why vLLM, not native Transformers, was selected as the runtime for this candidate.
runtime_support_evidence.sglang: Listed as a supported deployment option in the README; not selected this phase.
runtime_support_evidence.trust_remote_code: Not mentioned as required anywhere in the README or the official vLLM launch command.
